family: G_k = k renamed R44AS parents sharing one global pivot x; all five nonpivot variables remain block-disjoint
substitution_class: Maps target variables to signed source literals, repetitions allowed, with phi(-v)=-phi(v); every target clause image must be tautological or contain a source clause.

lower_bound.theorem: Every valid substitution transport in either sibling direction has deviation support at least k.
lower_bound.proof: If fewer than k variables deviate, some target block is pointwise fixed. Every clause of that block then remains the same non-tautological clause. Because source blocks are variable-disjoint, any source clause contained in such an image must come from the corresponding source block. This would be the identity local transport on the base R44AS sibling pair, excluded in both directions by R44BQ.

finite_upper_bound: In B_k->A_k, apply the R44BP signed permutation independently in all k blocks; this is a valid substitution of deviation support 5k.
consequence: For every fixed K choose k>K. Then no many-to-one signed literal substitution safe-delete certificate with deviation support<=K exists in either direction on this maxdef-critical both-nonterminal sibling pair.
remaining_open: Polynomial discovery of unbounded-support substitutions exploiting critical structure.
